method.loudness: ITU-R BS.1770 K weighting; stereo; 400 ms windows, 100 ms hops; -70 LUFS absolute/-10 LU relative gating
method.meter_crosscheck: FFmpeg ebur128 sine and gated-burst fixtures agree within 0.04 LU
method.phrase: 6.4 s: three 180 ms notes then a 4 s hold and 1 s tail, velocity110; bass/acid E2, others C4
method.stress: 4 s, three registers -12/0/+12, full-velocity single bass/acid or four-note chords; all six performance macros at maximum after2s
method.gain: Static post-FX reference gain; existing macro gain compensation, envelopes and tone retained
method.effects: Small room only on21 previously dry keyboard/organ sounds; basses kept dry
method.reset_policy: Every reference capture calls prepareToPlay, which resets peak protection. Removing a redundant reset on live preset changes does not alter those captures; queued-output continuity is checked separately.

limits: Matching applies to the documented reference phrase. Register, MIDI density, velocity, macros and user edits change perceived loudness. Clean output safety remains active for stress peaks. Historical 0.9.3 audits describe the earlier bank revision.
